title: Second-stage switching bound for an AND of DNFs
statement:
Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\{0,1\}$ be a Boolean function on $n\ge 1$ variables, and write $D(h)$ for the decision-tree depth of a Boolean function $h$, i.e. the least depth of a decision tree computing it. Suppose $f$ is the conjunction $f=g_1\wedge\cdots\wedge g_{s_2}$ of DNF formulas $g_1,\dots,g_{s_2}$, meaning $f(x)=1$ exactly when $g_i(x)=1$ for every $i$. Fix a restriction $\rho_1$ on the $n$ variables such that each restricted gate satisfies $D(g_i\!\restriction\!\rho_1)\le l$, where $l\ge 1$, and let $t$ be a natural number. Suppose $0<p_2\le \tfrac{1}{40l}$ (so in particular $p_2\le 1$), and let $\rho_2$ be a Bernoulli($p_2$) random restriction — each variable independently left free with probability $p_2$ and fixed to $0$ or $1$ with probability $(1-p_2)/2$ each. Writing $\rho_1\circ\rho_2$ for the composite restriction that applies $\rho_1$ first and then $\rho_2$ on the coordinates left free by $\rho_1$, we have
\[
\Pr_{\rho_2}\!\big[\, D\big(f\!\restriction\!(\rho_1\circ\rho_2)\big) > t \,\big]\;\le\;\left(\tfrac12\right)^{t}+\exp\!\big(-n\,p_2/3\big).
\]
hypotheses_covered: f is the AND of the DNF gates g_1,...,g_{s_2}
each restricted gate g_i↾ρ₁ has decision-tree depth ≤ l
ρ₂ drawn from the Bernoulli(p₂) restriction distribution
replaced:
Suppose $f$ is the AND of the gates and, under the first-stage restriction $\rho_1$,
each restricted gate has decision-tree depth $\le l$ (with $l > 0$, $n > 0$). Then for
any $0 < p_2 \le 1/(40l)$ the second-stage Bernoulli$(p_2)$ restriction satisfies
$\Pr_{\rho_2}[\mathrm{dtDepth}(\mathrm{restrictFn}\, f\,(\mathrm{composeRestr}\,\rho_1\,\rho_2)) > t]
\le (1/2)^t + \exp(-np_2/3)$.
